subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers review/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/829, replace it with a narrow OpenClaw PR, or keep waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The remaining bug is narrow and source-proven, but an open fork PR already owns the patch shape and maintainers cannot modify that branch directly.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: If the patch still fits current main, review or adopt it and let this issue close after the fix merges.

options.title: Replace with a narrow PR
options.body: If the fork branch is not usable, open a focused replacement touching the shared helper and regression test only.

options.title: Keep waiting on contributor
options.body: Use this only if maintainers want the fork author to update the branch before any replacement work starts.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: If the patch still fits current main, review or adopt it and let this issue close after the fix merges.
